infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vibes uses your camera so you can take profile photos and cover images for events or challenges, for example taking a new profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vibes uses your photo library so you can choose profile photos and cover images for events or challenges, for example uploading a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vibes uses your location while the app is open to suggest nearby people and events, for example filling in your city during onboarding.
